response_summary: Verified the assigned branch and live main baseline, reviewed the role/operating guides and current plus historical lifecycle implementation, and committed the first intake plan and contract audit. No shared semantics were changed.
Hardened lifecycle replay against malformed persisted task-state values; added regression tests for non-string and unknown states and documented fail-closed behavior.

Hardened lifecycle replay against malformed persisted record shapes by validating task snapshots and event records as mappings before field access; added regression tests and documented fail-closed behavior.

Hardened the in-memory lifecycle store write boundary against non-mapping task/event records and missing event identity; added regression tests and documented fail-closed rejection before mutation. Test execution was not performed in this environment.

Hardened replay against malformed event collection values returned by a store adapter; added regression coverage for null, scalar, mapping, and string collections and documented fail-closed behavior. Test execution was not performed in this environment.

Hardened the in-memory lifecycle store write boundary to reject non-string/empty identities and non-integer counters, including booleans masquerading as 1; added regression tests and documented pre-mutation rejection. Tests were not executed in this environment.

Hardened lifecycle-store idempotency boundaries: transition writes now require a non-empty string key/fingerprint pair, and direct idempotency lookups validate task/key/fingerprint before dictionary access. Added regression coverage and documentation. Tests were not executed in this environment.

Hardened the public lifecycle transition API to reject malformed task IDs, target/event types, empty idempotency keys, non-mapping details, invalid expected-version types, and non-boolean guard flags before store access; added no-mutation regression coverage and documented the boundary. Tests were not executed in this environment.

Hardened cancellation request and stop-confirmation API inputs: validate task identity, expected-version types, reason type, and strict boolean stop acknowledgement before store/idempotency access; added no-mutation regression coverage and documentation. Tests were not executed in this environment.

Hardened task creation and replay API input boundaries: non-mapping origins are rejected before conversion/persistence, and malformed replay task identifiers are rejected before store access. Added regression tests and documented the checks; test execution remains NOT RUN.

Strengthened replay integrity: validate task snapshot mapping, requested-task identity, and known state before reading events. Added regression tests for mismatched snapshot identity and malformed snapshot state, and documented fail-closed behavior. Tests remain NOT RUN.

Made the replay malformed-event-collection regression test restore its patched store method in a finally block, preserving test isolation even when an assertion fails. No lifecycle behavior or shared contract semantics changed.

Added replay regression coverage proving persisted task snapshot versions must be exact integers matching event count; boolean, float, and string counters are rejected. Documented the strict replay invariant; no shared lifecycle semantics changed.

Hardened replay integrity checks for the provisional event envelope: validate schema version, timestamp presence, bounded correlation ID, and origin kind; added malformed-value regression coverage including non-string origin kinds, and documented the checks. Test execution remains NOT RUN.

Strengthened replay event-envelope validation so occurred_at values must parse as timezone-aware ISO date-times; added regression coverage for invalid calendar/time values, timezone-naive timestamps, and malformed strings, and documented the rule. Test execution remains NOT RUN.
